risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (295.2) combined with high earnings risk in 13 days creates severe near-term volatility headwinds for AOS despite normal yield curve and flat dollar.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, Supertrend bullish) with market in fear zone (39/100) offers contrarian setup if price holds support at 75.92.
